records.aiNotes: Benzene and the neutral substituted product each have three alternating ring double bonds. In the sigma-complex the attacked carbon has two ring single bonds plusH andE (four sigma bonds,sp3); it has no remaining pi bond. Loss ofH+ followed by the restored third pi bond is correct; E replacesH. No hydride departure, retained aromatic sigma-complex or four-bond positive carbon is drawn. Native and316/360/680 cap448 viewed.
